{{Quote|While Corsin's prior government established large habitats for the animals, the current Imperial regime has chosen not to prosecute violations of the statutes and is authorizing development of some habitat areas.|Holobrochure for the Tagge Holographic Museum of Chandrila|<ref name="Creatures">''[[Creatures of the Galaxy]]''</ref>}}
